title: Second coordinate influence
statement:
Let $F$ be the function on ${-1,1}^3$ given, for $x=(x_0,x_1,x_2)$, by
\[
F(x)=\frac{t+1}{4}+\frac{t}{4}x_1+\frac{t}{4}x_2-\frac14x_0x_1+\frac14x_0x_2+\frac{t-1}{4}x_1x_2,
\qquad t=2+\frac{\sqrt{33}}{3}.
\]
With the uniform probability measure on the sign cube, the squared $L^2$ norm of the difference between $F$ and its average over coordinate $2$ is $\frac56+\frac{\sqrt{33}}8$.
